scope: E73-only mechanical repair candidate, not yet selected by the canonical assembly/firmware/render pipeline. Bounded design dimensions are measured acceptance requirements, not supplier guarantees.

plate.position_error_scope: Includes translation, rotation and deformation at every point; not a separate 0.1 mm allowance for each source of error
plate.maximum_installed_surface_error_Z_scope: Combined error of each installed plate face, including finished thickness, flatness, installed height and gasket compression; no separate ±0.1 mm credits for those terms.

switch.height_scope: Incoming and installed measurement including solder and actuator; a project acceptance envelope, not a maximum certified by the nominal manufacturer drawing

gaskets.material_qualification: Cut-to-fit foam; compression force, creep and adhesive retention require first article
